sources.title: H.-O. Georgii, Large deviations and the equivalence of ensembles for Gibbsian particle systems with superstable interaction
sources.locator: Complete 25-page author-hosted PDF read; Sections 2–7, especially Definitions 2.1–2.4, Theorems 1, 2 and 4, Lemmas 3.1, 4.3 and 7.1; printed pp.172–195 / PDF pp.2–25.

contents.support: Supplies the interaction hypotheses and conventions; the local definition spells out the chosen cube norm, units and Poisson normalization.

contents.support: Supports the small-cell repulsion count and stable-part lower bound used by the local coercivity lemma.

contents.support: Supports the energy-density interface; the local proof records the superstable hypotheses and the truncation argument.

contents.support: Supports the free-cube limit; exact exponential particle cutoff and separated-core comparison are written in the item proof.

contents.name: Section 4, Lemma 4.3: periodic/free energy discrepancy with a corridor
contents.support: Supplies the exact tail-times-cell-square inequality used for the periodic fixed-particle lower bound.

contents.name: Theorem 2 and Sections 4–5: stationary variational pressure
contents.support: Supplies the source variational route; local entropy compactness and the exact normalization conversion are independently stated.

contents.name: Theorem 4: density interval and upper energy-density event
contents.support: The complete proof establishes the interval event exponent and common variational minimizers for the periodized empirical fields, under the stated nondegeneracy and strict-feasibility conditions.

contents.name: Section 6: uniformly tempered exterior boundary
contents.support: Supports the near/far exterior comparison under a genuine positive divergent core and the explicit square-count tempering class.

contents.name: Lemma 7.1: attainable density interval and fixed-density preparations
contents.support: Supports the interior attainable-density convention; the exact-N slab packing and correction-core proof is local.

contents.support: The source defines positive-beta Gibbs weights for interactions taking +infinity, but it does not state a beta-zero partition-rate theorem. This item derives the pointwise retained-admissibility branch and rate locally.
